info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Service Retrieval API enables users to access details of operational services based on specific parameters. Through this API endpoint, consumers can retrieve information pertaining to open item management by supplying the required param1. This functionality is particularly valuable for banking institutions and financial services that require quick access to operational data for reporting and analysis. Typical use cases include customer support, operational audits, and data reconciliation.

get.description: Fetch detailed information about the open item with the specified ID. This endpoint provides comprehensive data regarding the item's current status, associated transactions, and relevant metadata.
